details: Former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, currently serving a 25-year sentence, has officially filed for a presidential pardon from Donald Trump. This development comes as the FTT token has seen a significant price increase.
title: Sam Bankman-Fried Files for Presidential Pardon

details: Strategy, a prominent corporate Bitcoin holder, has acquired an additional 1,550 BTC for approximately $101 million, raising its total Bitcoin holdings to 845,256 BTC. This follows a recent sale and brings their cash reserves to $1 billion.
title: Strategy Increases Bitcoin Holdings with New Purchase

details: Bitmine, an Ethereum treasury giant, has reportedly increased its Ethereum holdings, now holding 5.54 million ETH, bringing it closer to its target of holding 5% of the total ETH supply. This signifies strong institutional accumulation of Ethereum.
title: Ethereum Treasury Giant Bitmine Expands ETH Holdings

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a significant surge after its developers successfully patched a critical vulnerability within the Orchard shielded pool, enhancing the network's security.
title: Zcash Price Rises Following Security Fix

details: Bitcoin rebounded past $64,000, driven by a substantial short squeeze that liquidated over $460 million in short positions. This recovery follows a period of market weakness and significant outflows from Bitcoin ETFs earlier in the week. The overall crypto market capitalization has also seen a modest increase in the last 24 hours after a decline.
title: Bitcoin Reclaims $64K Amid Market Recovery
